review_items: The user has restored the spacious 7,000 sq ft direction, allowing local internal-access changes and basement/roof footprint/core alignment while retaining their functions. Study 007 compact direction is superseded and preserved separately. This 70 x 100 ft candidate is not an approved legal plot or engineering design.

There is NO external covered stair link and NO extra strip between the main house and driveway. The only above-ground annex is the 60 sq ft front-lawn shaft reserve. Internal Front Galleries meet full-floor front stair landings; the lift never opens at a half-turn or through a bedroom.

Main ground/first plates return to 50 x 50 ft = 2,500 sq ft, plus a 60 sq ft front lift annex each. The basement retains its clean-front / garage-rear arrangement, widened to 50 ft for alignment rather than reverted to an old basement design.

Ground is proposed 1.5 ft above road, basement -8.5 ft, first +12.5 ft and roof +23.5 ft. Basement-to-ground rise stays 10 ft. The slightly raised house helps the sampled ramp roof clearance; entry steps, drainage, accessible arrival and legal levels require design.

Ground restores front drawing/guest rooms divided by Entrance Gallery and the transverse House Gallery, with common WC left and utility cupboard right. Drawing is 314.5 sq ft; master sleeping 344, dressing 118.75 and bath 80.75. A 4 ft internal stair-access strip narrows the guest room to 9.5 x 17 ft / 123 sq ft net after its ensuite while retaining front glazing. These are local access adjustments, not identical old room dimensions.

All three child sleeping rooms return to 16 x 17 ft = 272 sq ft. Office is front-left and Child 1 front-right; the 49 x 7 ft transverse lounge divides them from the two rear bedrooms. Child 1 bath/dressing move behind its room to preserve internal stair access. Private suite entries and 3 ft inside dressing approaches remain clear.

Basement gym and gaming are 387.75 sq ft net EACH. The shaft corner is subtracted from gaming, not double-counted. Existing equipment and recreation functions remain; simultaneous operating/play clearances and six-month storage capacity need review.

Family living is 377 gross minus 48 sq ft pantry and 12 sq ft cupboard = 317 net, including open prayer/circulation. Dining is 138 sq ft with eight chair footprints; kitchen is 168 sq ft. Areas are not added twice; service and operating clearances need review.

All five beds have headboards against solid walls and two bedside tables/lamps. Master has one wall-backed WC, one basin, bathtub and separate shower. Guest ensuite is 5.5 x 7 ft with a 3 x 3 ft enclosed shower; pocket-door operation and all plumbing/accessibility need review.

Public gallery/dining screens and an offset 6.5 ft doorless entry protect the family suite. Living, dining and kitchen share open routes, not internal doors. Sampled entrance sightlines are checked against full-height wall intent, not the low display cutaway; all-position privacy/acoustics are not certified.

The utility cupboard is off the right end of House Gallery beside the stair zone, not drawing or an external corridor. Refrigerator is inside the enlarged pantry. Food/storage capacity, appliance clearances, child-safe cleaning storage and ventilation need review.

Three SUV bays are at the front of the GARAGE compartment only. A rear arrival aisle and widened 24 ft portal serve the tangent curve. Sampled 5.25 x 2.25 x 2.2 m body/overhang sweep plus 0.3 m buffer, eased grades, roof and underside margins are checked. Independent bay exit/reversing, mirror clearance, road approach, dynamics and engineering remain unverified.

Driveway straight lane is 12 ft, widening to 15 ft around a 19 ft rear-axle radius. Candidate maximum grades are 14% straight and 10% curved. No legal-grade, flood, retaining-wall, slip-resistance or drainage certification is implied.

The garage remains separated by intended sealed full-height construction, two self-closing airlock doors and protected clean routes. Independent exhaust/makeup air, negative pressure, CO/NO2 monitoring, fire/egress and commissioning are unresolved.
Garage and kitchen exhaust outlets are UNLOCATED and must avoid windows, play lawn/veranda, neighbouring land and fresh-air intakes. A window or fan location is not proof of air quality.

The 8 x 16 ft rear-right pool is restored outside the basement footprint and driveway. Its enclosure/gate is modeled, not child-safety certified. Pool structure, excavation separation, drainage, waterproofing and servicing need engineering. Fishpond and double-height atrium remain deferred.

Front/back bands return to approximately 20% / 30% of plot depth, with a 48 x 15 ft play lawn and rear planting reserve. Ramp/path areas are not play lawn. The raised rear grade, fill/retaining, basement deck, soil depth, roots and drainage need engineering; no mature mini-forest is established.

Roof stair headhouse, front lift-head display reserve and open-sided ramp canopy are separate inspection geometry. Covers reduce rain/sun exposure, not flooding or windblown dust. Inlet/interceptor drains, sump/backup pumps, waterproofing, wind, ventilation and fire require specialists.

The 9 x 17 ft front-entry U-stair retains 4 ft flights/landings, 12 in goings and twenty risers; actual slab voids follow its direction. Headroom, handrail/guard projections, lift product/pit/overrun and code/fire/accessibility remain unverified. Lift is not evacuation egress.

Shared balconies have no internal dividers. The front deck ends before the shaft and has a shared gallery door; rear common access is retained. Guards, insect screens, privacy/shading and daylight/fresh-air performance need detailed design.

Structural view is a non-engineered proxy diagram, not member sizes or a proven load path. Roughly 49.5 ft spans remain substantial; an engineer may require internal columns, transfer systems or layout/budget changes.

No site is purchased. Setbacks, legal plot/buildable envelope, road, neighbours, jurisdiction, groundwater/soil, structural/seismic design, service equipment/LPG/batteries and cost remain unresolved. A geometry PASS is not construction approval.
